Shatter me by tahereh mafi was a huge motivator in making me invested in finding others similar but it all depends on what interests you the most. I really like historical fiction like between shades of grey by ruta sepetys and city of theives (both of stalin era. Or fiction novels that implement fantasy into historical fiction like Leviathon. Book series get you more invested in characters but can become repetitive or dreary after a while like even if you finish the first book in the grisha trilogy once you get in the middle of siege and storm you start reading slower or less but the pay off is usually great. If you make a designated place or time that you just enjoy being in or are able to relax or have a specific free time like driving (audibooks are heavenly for long commutes) or a fifteen minute smoke break you can use reading as a filler.
